ui-refresh-0422.title: UI Refresh 2026-04-22 — Bound Edition
ui-refresh-0422.description: Post-D2 polish round: PageMasthead on every top-level surface, asymmetric EmptyState, capsule [t+12s] ledger counter, paper grain, send-button breath, Stop button full Rust, five-paw progress contrast bump, Settings sectioning + fleuron, plus two one-liners on uxfb-3/4 code (AgentTrace left-rule color, CollapsePill summary register). D1 token system, Track A row model, motion vocabulary, folded-paper chrome unchanged. Aligned with uxfb-1 -> uxfb-followup (commit 08ae6378).
acceptCriteria: Final gates subtask complete (gradle clean+lint+test green, /verify, /ux-visual-debug, doc/main/ui/style.md and user_interaction.md updated)

ui-refresh-0422-phase1-primitives.title: Phase 1 — Theme primitives (Ornaments + PaperGrain + Fraunces)
ui-refresh-0422-phase1-primitives.description: Add ui/theme/Ornaments.kt with Fleuron() and PageMasthead() composables. Add ui/theme/PaperGrain.kt with Modifier.paperGrain() (1.5%-alpha noise tile baked once via drawWithCache; no-op in dark theme; lanternVignette() seam for dark). Decide Fraunces approach: ship fraunces_medium.ttf (Option A) or retire upright Fraunces (Option B); update Type.kt FontFamily accordingly. No call sites change yet — primitives only.
acceptCriteria: Fraunces approach (A or B) documented in commit message or doc

ui-refresh-0422-phase2-page-chrome.title: Phase 2 — PageMasthead on top-level surfaces + paperGrain + Settings sectioning + live pill
ui-refresh-0422-phase2-page-chrome.description: Brand chrome on every top-level surface. ChatHeader: replace center title with PageMasthead. NavigationDrawer DrawerHeader: replace Sessions text with PageMasthead. SettingsHomePage: prepend PageMasthead, wrap nav rows in three sections (Voice/Behavior/System) with serif-italic SectionHeader, add Fleuron above mono version footer. ChatScreen: wrap root in paperGrain Box (light only); restyle live-pill to mono with explicit border. todayLabel() helper added (DateFormat.getMediumDateFormat).

ui-refresh-0422-phase3-chat-ornaments.title: Phase 3 — Chat content ornaments + 2 one-liners on uxfb-3/4 code
ui-refresh-0422-phase3-chat-ornaments.description: MessageBubble.UserBubble: drop Surface, add 1dp Hairline left margin rule, mono timestamp inline (letter-to-the-editor). ThinkingIndicator: drop Surface(surfaceVariant) chip, render PawToeSequence + Thinking… (bodyItalic, inkMuted) inline. AgentTrace.kt:109 — bump 2dp left rule color from outlineVariant (8%) to outline (Hairline 12%); rule is now the *primary* turn marker after ✱ glyph removed in uxfb-4. CollapsePill.kt:72 — swap summary text style from labelLarge (Geist) to monoSmall so chevron+summary read as one ledger object. Both one-liners are P2; flag to original uxfb-3/4 author before merge.
acceptCriteria: Pinned tests pass: ThinkingIndicatorTintTest, ThinkingIndicatorCadenceTest, ChatDoneBridgeTest, CollapsePillTest, ThoughtGroupTest
QA test tags preserved: qa-user-bubble, qa-thinking-indicator, qa-agent-bubble, qa-collapse-pill, qa-final-answer

ui-refresh-0422-phase4-empty-state.title: Phase 4 — EmptyState asymmetric rebuild + staggered reveal
ui-refresh-0422-phase4-empty-state.description: Full rewrite of EmptyState: 240dp paw bleeds top-right at 80% Ink (clipped by Box bounds), Fraunces italic 32sp question ("What can I help you with?") aligned bottom-left lower-third, Hairline 64dp rule, three marginalia suggestions (verb in bodyLarge / gloss in Fraunces italic / leading → arrow). StaggeredReveal helper: 4 steps × TraceEnter (240ms) at 80ms intervals. Reduced-motion: instant render. paperGrain on root Box. Drop the "…" ASCII quotes around suggestions (wrong attribution).
ui-refresh-0422-phase4-empty-state.note: DONE. Follow-up: app/src/androidTest/.../ChatEmptyStateTest.kt asserts old chip shape (3 suggestion chips); instrumented test, not in unit-test gate, fold into final-gates QA pass.

ui-refresh-0422-phase5-capsule-onboardin.title: Phase 5 — Capsule polish + onboarding + StartupErrorBanner
ui-refresh-0422-phase5-capsule-onboardin.description: SmartCapsuleSurface: produceElapsedLabel(mode) ticker (LaunchedEffect + delay 1s); CapsuleStatusLine renders [t+12s] mono ledger as its OWN Text BEFORE the marqueed thought (uxfb-2 contract — paw and ledger stay fixed, thought scrolls). CapsuleControlBar Stop button: explicit BorderStroke(1.dp, colorScheme.error). CapsuleInputBar send button: 240ms breath on submit (Animatable scale 1.0->1.04->1.0; reduced-motion skips). SmartCapsuleSurface StartupErrorBanner: 2dp Rust left rule + ⚠ glyph (monoBody, error). OnboardingShell FivePawProgress: unfilled tint outlineVariant -> closePaw.inkFaint (visible in light mode).

ui-refresh-0422-final-gates.title: Final gates — verify + UX visual debug + doc sync + archive
ui-refresh-0422-final-gates.description: Final verification gate. Run gradle clean+lint+test (all green). Run /verify skill. Run /ux-visual-debug for: cold launch -> EmptyState; send message -> ChatHeader masthead visible; trigger long task -> capsule [t+Xs] ticker; open drawer -> masthead + ledger dates; open settings -> sections + fleuron. Update doc/main/ui/style.md (add Fleuron, PageMasthead, paperGrain, ledger counter sections). Update doc/main/ui/user_interaction.md (mastheaded surfaces list, EmptyState marginalia layout, capsule running counter behavior). Archive projects/active/ui-refresh-0422/ -> doc/archive/20260422_ui-refresh/.
acceptCriteria: /ux-visual-debug produces screenshots covering: EmptyState, ChatHeader masthead, capsule [t+Xs] running, drawer masthead, settings sections+fleuron
ui-refresh-0422-final-gates.note: Human sign-off received 2026-05-01. All gates green per prior verification.
